boundary: Post-development description of original selected-best, single-seed saved query results versus fixed independent global. AP gain/loss signs are exact saved floating-point comparisons, not statistical significance. All queries and identities retained; identity macro is equal weight per identity and does not replace query mAP. Four Rank-1 outcome groups partition queries; unchanged Rank-1 does not imply unchanged AP. Gross loss sums only negative AP changes; the largest identity fraction uses that gross-loss denominator, not net mAP. No same-model branch causality, unique failure cause, raw-GT reauthentication, deployable GT gate, NN, training, candidate or method selection.
